title: Data Optimization for LLMs: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.33405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have attracted great attention in both academic and industrial communities in recent years. Numerous survey studies have covered various aspects of LLMs, such as learning strategies, applications, alignment, explainability, and evaluation. However, little headway has been made in reviewing data-related aspects for LLMs, despite data being recognized as a key factor contributing to the emergence of the LLMs era. A wide range of data optimization algorithms and techniques are employed in LLMs' training and application processes. These techniques often originate from diverse deep learning domains, with their theoretical inspirations and heuristic motivations appearing unrelated to each other. This study aims to develop a comprehensive framework for LLMs' data optimization techniques to enhance data utilization and efficiency. translated_title: 大语言模型的数据优化：综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）近年来在学术界和工业界都引起了极大的关注。众多综述研究已经涵盖了LLMs的各个方面，例如学习策略、应用、对齐、可解释性和评估。然而，尽管数据被公认为是促成LLMs时代出现的关键因素，但在对LLMs数据相关方面进行综述的进展却甚少。在LLMs的训练和应用过程中，采用了广泛的数据优化算法和技术。这些技术通常源自不同的深度学习领域，其理论灵感和启发式动机看起来彼此无关。本研究旨在为LLMs的数据优化技术开发一个全面的框架，以提升数据利用率和效率。我们首先讨论LLMs训练和推理中的数据挑战。其次，我们总结了……
tldr: 本综述填补了LLMs数据层面综述的空白，首次构建了一个统一框架，系统梳理了源自不同深度学习领域的数据优化技术，以提升大语言模型训练与推理中的数据利用率和效率。
